_comment: Morning Brief starter (ship plan P4, 2026-11-27). Public and generic: asks the person's city and a few topics, then each morning they ask for it, writes a short linked brief as an AI Write document, puts it at the top of For You (Mac and iPhone) and can read it aloud to their iPhone. The deterministic half is morning-brief/tools/brief.py (linked into the working folder by workdirLinks): news-search and RSS feeds, a recency window, and a seen-ledger so a story used once is not offered again for 30 days. The model only writes prose over the items the tool chose. Its own assistant, not a mode of `news` (Reading) or `coordinator`: those are the owner's, their CONTEXT.md and grants are tuned to his routine, and a starter must not inherit either. Nothing about any one person or city is in this folder.
blurb: Your city and the topics you follow, in one short page each morning with a link for every story; it can read it aloud to your iPhone.
_whyCadenceManual: The legacy cadence job composes the Swift calendar-and-sources brief and spawns no session, so `daily` here would add a second, different brief rather than run this one; per-assistant schedules are not built (ASSISTANT_SDK_ARCHITECTURE AS.4, Routines R11). The person asks for it; CONTEXT.md says so plainly instead of promising a schedule.
_whyState: memories: the city, the topics (each with its search words) and whether they want it read aloud, a handful of preference facts. artifacts: the dated AI Write brief and its audio. evidence: every line of the brief links its source. No records: the seen-ledger is the tool's state file, not a series the person reads.
_whyFreshness: brief.py state/seen.json in the working folder: after a brief is published, mark-seen records the stories it used (URL and headline), and collect never offers them again for 30 days. A new thread starts a fresh ledger, which can repeat one morning's stories once; CONTEXT.md tells the thread to carry state/ over when it can.
_whyQualityControl: deterministic: brief.py chooses the candidates (recency, repeats, seen-ledger); the model writes only from items.json. evidence: each line in the brief carries the link of the item it came from, and items are a headline, a short snippet and a link, never a rehosted article.
_whyAudiocastIsEnumerated: audiocast has dangerous verbs (publishEpisode puts a file on the open internet under the person's name). Only create, which renders on their Mac and delivers to their own iPhone, is granted; a public podcast feed is not part of this starter.
_whyPublishDailyUpdate: It writes one brief record from the AI Write document, which leads For You on the Mac and reaches the iPhone through iCloud. It sends nothing outside the app.
_whyBudget: Advisory, checked only when another assistant relays a question here. One brief is a few short turns over at most 40 candidate headlines.
